page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture using dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. The configuration delivers 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system features 128 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU. It lacks dedicated local storage and onboard GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage while offering a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Supported CPU instruction sets include AVX and AVX-512 extensions alongside AES hardware acceleration.

Benchmark evaluation reveals modest single-core execution capabilities combined with mid-range multi-threaded performance. Single-core tests such as stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the lower tier of cloud offerings, backed by a single-threaded Gzip compression throughput of 19.05 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks show average throughput, achieving a multi-core stress-ng score of 23,406.46, a PassMark CPU score of 23,344.34, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8,312.0. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 119.7 GB/sec for large block reads and 55.79 GB/sec for writes.

From an operational perspective, the server exhibits sustained mid-tier efficiency for concurrent throughput tasks despite limited single-thread speed. Redis SET operations reach 23.48 million operations per second, and static web serving delivers 14.04 GB/sec. For artificial intelligence tasks, medium 7B model prompt processing yields 40.06 tokens per second. The instance provides a balanced hardware profile without attached local storage overhead, making it suitable for general-purpose application hosting, web server clusters, medium-scale database processing, and container orchestration tasks where thread scaling outweighs individual core clock efficiency.
